method: Meridian discovery.discover fetched public read-only ATS endpoints; first returned job normalized and persisted into an isolated temporary SQLite database. No applications or candidate data were sent.
finding_corrected: Initial 8 MB cap rejected the two largest feeds; official public ATS feeds now have a bounded 64 MB cap. Arbitrary pages remain capped at 8 MB. Counts are time-specific, not seeded into the product.
